universal.zh: 一台燃油車可以拆成幾個系統：引擎產生動力、變速箱與傳動把動力送到輪子、底盤與懸吊撐住車身並處理路面、煞車與轉向讓你控制它、電系把一切串起來。學會這些系統怎麼接在一起，看任何燃油車都是同一套邏輯。
universal.en: A petrol car breaks down into systems: the engine makes power, the transmission and driveline carry it to the wheels, chassis and suspension hold the body and handle the road, brakes and steering let you control it, and the electrical system ties everything together. Learn how these connect and every petrol car reads the same way.

specific.zh: F30 是第六代 3 系列四門轎車，前置引擎、後輪驅動。320i 用 N20 2.0 升渦輪四缸引擎縱置在前軸後方，電瓶放在後車廂配重。
specific.en: The F30 is the sixth-generation 3 Series sedan: front engine, rear-wheel drive. The 320i uses the N20 2.0 L turbo four, mounted longitudinally behind the front axle, with the battery in the trunk for weight balance.

universal.zh: 車身是所有東西的骨架。現代轎車是「單體式車身」：鈑金本身就是結構，引擎、懸吊都鎖在它上面，沒有獨立的大樑。
universal.en: The body is the skeleton everything bolts to. Modern sedans use a unibody: the sheet metal is the structure itself, with engine and suspension mounted to it; there is no separate ladder frame.

specific.zh: 這裡的車殼只是用簡化幾何拼出的輪廓，讓你認得引擎在車上的相對位置。車身是結構件，模擬器裡不能拆。等你放入授權乾淨的 F30 模型後，只要改這筆資料的 modelRef 就能替換。
specific.en: This shell is a simplified silhouette so you can see where the engine sits in the car. The body is structural, so it cannot be removed here. Once you add a properly licensed F30 model, change this part's modelRef and it swaps in.

warnings.en: The body is structural and cannot be removed.

universal.zh: 蓋住引擎室的鈑金件，靠兩個鉸鏈和一支氣壓撐桿或撐桿固定。保養時只要打開；要吊出整顆引擎時才需要整片拆下。
universal.en: The panel over the engine bay, held by two hinges and gas struts or a prop. You only open it for servicing; it comes off completely only when the whole engine is pulled.

specific.zh: F30 的引擎蓋是鋁合金材質（待查證），鉸鏈上有行人保護的彈起機構。模擬器裡為了看清楚引擎，可以整片拆下。
specific.en: The F30 bonnet is aluminium (unverified) and the hinges carry a pedestrian-protection pop-up mechanism. In the simulator you can remove it entirely to see the engine.

warnings.zh: 拆鉸鏈前先在鉸鏈周圍描線，裝回時才對得準縫隙。
warnings.en: Mark around the hinges before unbolting so the panel gaps line up on refit.

warnings.zh: 需要兩個人扶，避免刮傷擋風玻璃。
warnings.en: Two people needed so the bonnet does not hit the windscreen.

universal.zh: 塑膠外皮加鋁或鋼的防撞樑。拆它不是為了保桿本身，而是為了後面的水箱、中冷器與大燈。
universal.en: A plastic skin over an aluminium or steel crash beam. You remove it to reach the radiator, intercooler and headlights behind it.

specific.zh: F30 前保桿由輪拱內襯、底部與上方格柵處的螺絲固定，兩側卡在葉子板的導軌上，要往前抽。
specific.en: The F30 bumper is held by screws in the arch liners, underneath and at the grille, and slides forward off rails on the wings.

warnings.zh: 兩側先往外扳開卡扣再往前抽，硬拉會斷導軌。
warnings.en: Unclip the sides outward before pulling forward; forcing it snaps the rails.

warnings.zh: 有駐車雷達、霧燈接頭要先拔。
warnings.en: Unplug parking sensors and fog lights first.

universal.zh: 和前保桿一樣是外皮加防撞樑。
universal.en: Like the front: a skin over a crash beam.

specific.zh: 拆後保桿才看得到後消音器的吊耳與尾管。
specific.en: Removing it exposes the rear silencer hangers and tailpipes.

universal.zh: 靠兩個鉸鏈和扭力彈簧或撐桿固定。
universal.en: Hung on two hinges with torsion springs or struts.

specific.zh: F30 電瓶在行李廂右側地板下，換電瓶不用拆蓋，只要打開。模擬器允許整片拆下方便看。
specific.en: The F30 battery sits under the boot floor on the right; you only open the lid to reach it. The simulator lets you remove the lid to see inside.

warnings.zh: 鉸鏈先描線再拆，裝回縫隙才對。
warnings.en: Mark the hinges first so the gaps line up on refit.

universal.zh: 引擎下方的塑膠板，擋水擋石頭、也幫空氣力學。幾乎所有從車底做的工作都要先拆它。
universal.en: The plastic panel under the engine keeps water and stones out and smooths airflow. Almost any job from underneath starts by removing it.

specific.zh: F30 底護板用約 8–10 顆 8 mm 螺絲（待查證）固定，換機油、拆油底殼、拆排氣前段都要先拆。
specific.en: The F30 undertray is held by roughly 8–10 8 mm screws (unverified). Oil changes, sump removal and downpipe work all start here.

warnings.zh: 先把車頂起來、架好頂車架，不要只靠千斤頂。
warnings.en: Lift the car and set it on stands; never work under a jack alone.

universal.zh: 過濾進到車廂的空氣：擋灰塵、花粉，有活性碳的還能吸一部分臭味。濾網塞住時冷氣風量會變小、車內有霉味。
universal.en: Filters the air coming into the cabin: dust and pollen, and with activated carbon some odours. A clogged one cuts the fan output and makes the cabin smell musty.

specific.zh: F30 的冷氣濾網在引擎室後方、擋風玻璃下的進氣飾蓋底下（確切拆法與片數待查證）。BMW 的 CBS 有監控它的更換時間。
specific.en: On the F30 the microfilter sits at the back of the engine bay under the cowl cover below the windscreen (exact removal steps and number of elements unverified). BMW CBS tracks its replacement.

warnings.zh: 拆飾蓋時雨刷要先立起來或拆下，卡扣是塑膠的，冷天容易斷。
warnings.en: Raise or remove the wipers before the cowl cover; the plastic clips snap easily when cold.

commonIssues.zh: 開冷氣有霉味、風量變小：先換濾網，再考慮清蒸發器。
commonIssues.en: Musty smell or weak airflow with the A/C on: replace the filter before blaming the evaporator.

universal.zh: 刷片的橡膠會被日曬、高溫和臭氧弄硬，刷不乾淨就該換。換刷片不用拆雨刷臂。
universal.en: Sun, heat and ozone harden the rubber; once it streaks it is due. Changing blades does not need the arms removed.

specific.zh: F30 雨刷可以設定到「維修位置」再立起來（方法依年份不同，待查證），否則刷臂會打到引擎蓋。
specific.en: The F30 wipers have a service position before they can be lifted (method varies by year, unverified); otherwise the arms hit the bonnet.

warnings.zh: 刷臂立起來時不要讓它彈回去打到擋風玻璃。
warnings.en: Do not let a raised arm snap back onto the windscreen.

commonIssues.zh: 刷出一條一條水痕、跳動：刷片老化。
